metadata.title: Say It Like a Local! 🇯🇵✨ “まじで？” + 3 Quick Phrases
metadata.description: Want to sound more natural in Japanese—instantly? In this reel, you’ll learn how native speakers use “まじで？” (Seriously?/No way!) plus 3 super-practical follow-up phrases for real conversations. We’ll also cover quick pronunciation tips so you can say it confidently right away. Save this reel for later, comment your favorite phrase below, and follow Velocity Japanese for daily, fun lessons! #japanese #learnjapanese #japaneselanguage #nihongo #japaneselesson #velocityjapanese #kanji #japanesevocabulary #dailyjapanese #speakjapanese #studyjapanese #japantravel
